items.title: Dameon Pierce: Last back standing in Week 5 loss
items.text:
Pierce carried the ball 11 times for 14 yards and caught two of five targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Team-high six grabs in return
items.text:
Goedert caught six of nine targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jalen Hurts: Struggles again in Week 5 loss
items.text:
Hurts completed 21 of 40 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars. He added two rushing yards on two carries and lost one of two fumbles.

items.title: Kenyon Sadiq: Exits Sunday for concussion check
items.text:
Sadiq is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Browns after exiting in the third quarter to be evaluated for a head injury.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Makes early exit from Sunday's game
items.text:
The Patriots ruled out Henderson (ankle) for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Evan Lazar of the team's official site reports.
